title: In JetBrains YouTrack before 2026.2.19562 missing authorization allowed Project Admin to manage VCS hosting server…
description: A missing authorization vulnerability in JetBrains YouTrack versions before 2026.2.19562 allowed users with Project Admin privileges to manage version control system (VCS) hosting server configurations. This flaw could lead to unauthorized configuration changes impacting confidentiality, integrity, and availability. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.7.
